description_en: Issues a local debug token for a running high-code agent in a specified workspace. The latest configuration of the agent must take effect. The workspace must enable inbound access for the selected network and complete debug routing preparations. The token is valid for 1 hour from the time of issuance. You can call this operation again to obtain a new token after the token expires
description_zh: 为指定工作空间中已运行的高代码智能体签发本地调试令牌。智能体的最新配置须已生效，工作空间须已开启所选网络的入站访问并完成调试路由准备。令牌自签发起 1 小时内有效，过期后可重新调用本接口获取
name: CreateCustomAgentDebugToken

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the high-code agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 高代码智能体所属工作空间的 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the high-code agent to debug locally
parameters.help_zh: 要在本地调试的高代码智能体 ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The network type used for local debugging. INTERNET indicates public network access. INTRANET indicates access over a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh: 本地调试使用的网络类型。INTERNET 表示通过公网访问，INTRANET 表示通过专有网络（VPC）访问
parameters.name: network_type

code.description_en: The business status code. SUCCESS is returned if the call is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时返回 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The debug token issued in this request, the token fingerprint, and the corresponding resource and network information
data.description_zh: 本次签发的调试令牌、令牌指纹及其对应的资源和网络信息

agentId.description_en: The ID of the high-code agent corresponding to the token
agentId.description_zh: 本次令牌对应的高代码智能体 ID

bootstrapToken.description_en: The token used by the AgentCore SDK for local debugging. Keep the token secure. Do not write it to logs or commit it to code repositories
bootstrapToken.description_zh: 供 AgentCore SDK 在本地调试时使用的令牌。请妥善保管，避免写入日志或提交到代码仓库

networkType.description_en: The network type used for the token, which is the same as the networkType parameter in the request
networkType.description_zh: 本次令牌使用的网络类型，与请求中的 networkType 一致

tokenFingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint used to identify the issued token, which can be used to troubleshoot issuance records
tokenFingerprint.description_zh: 用于识别本次签发令牌的指纹，可用于排查签发记录

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace corresponding to the token
workspaceId.description_zh: 本次令牌对应的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

message.description_en: The description of the request processing result

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
